name: Smart Animate Text
description: Figma-style Smart Animate for words: letters shared between the old and new word glide to their new slots, new letters blur in and leftovers blur out.
a11y: Real text lives in an sr-only aria-live span; animated glyphs are aria-hidden. Reduced motion: crossfade with no movement.
perf: Layout animations on a handful of inline-block spans; popLayout keeps exits out of flow.
prompt: Build a Smart Animate text component with Motion: split the current word into characters keyed by lowercase letter + occurrence index (b-0, a-0, n-0, a-1…). Render each as a motion.span with layout="position" inside AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" so shared letters move to their new positions while new ones enter (opacity 0, blur 6px, y 8) and removed ones exit upward. Cycle words on an interval; keep an sr-only aria-live copy of the word.

name: Avatar Team Stack
description: Overlapping, slightly tilted avatars that fan out on hover or focus; the person under the pointer lifts and shows a name card.
a11y: Each avatar is a button labelled with name and role; works with keyboard focus; tap toggles on touch. Reduced motion: no lift, instant spread.
perf: Springs on margin/scale/rotate of a few elements.
prompt: Build an avatar stack with Motion: avatars overlap with negative margin and alternate ±4° tilt. On group hover/focus animate margins to a small positive gap (bouncy spring) and untilt; the hovered/focused avatar lifts (y −8, scale 1.12) and shows a small name/role card below via AnimatePresence. Each avatar is a labelled button.

name: Inline Link Mention
description: Notion-style inline mention pill inside running text that springs open a rich preview card (image, title, description, URL) on hover or keyboard focus.
a11y: Real <a> link; preview has role=tooltip and is wired with aria-describedby while open; opens on focus too. Reduced motion: fade only.
perf: Card mounts only while open; 180 ms open delay avoids flicker when the pointer passes over.
prompt: Build an inline mention link: a compact pill (icon + label, muted background) that, after a 180 ms hover/focus delay, shows a preview card below it with Motion (from y 6, scale .96, blur 4px; snappy spring, top-left origin). Close on leave/blur after 80 ms. Card: optional cover image, title, description, URL. Use role=tooltip + aria-describedby.

name: Orbital Image Wheel
description: Images arranged on a giant wheel whose hub sits below the frame. Drag, scroll or use arrow keys to turn it; it springs so one image sits enlarged at the top with its title.
a11y: Focusable region with arrow-key navigation; each image is a labelled button; title announced via aria-live. Reduced motion: snaps without spring.
perf: All positions are derived from one motion value with useTransform — no React re-render while turning.
props: Wheel radius as a fraction of width.
prompt: Build an orbital image wheel with Motion: one angle motion value; each item's rotation = base + angle, position = (sin, −cos)·R, and scale/opacity mapped from its angular distance to the top. Hub placed below the container. Pan adds delta/R in degrees; wheel adds deltaY; on end, spring to the nearest step (shortest way round). Arrow keys step. Show the active title below.

name: Depth Fade Carousel
description: A native scroll-snap carousel where each card's scale, tilt, blur and opacity depend on its distance from the centre — cards recede into depth as they slide away.
a11y: Native scrolling (swipe, trackpad, keyboard when focused); cards labelled “n of total”. Reduced motion: opacity only.
perf: rAF-throttled scroll handler writing transform/filter/opacity; zero layout reads per card except offsetLeft.
prompt: Build a depth-fade carousel: a horizontal overflow container with scroll-snap center and side padding so the first/last card can centre. On scroll (rAF-throttled) compute each card's distance d from the viewport centre in card widths (clamped ±1.5) and set transform perspective(900px) rotateY(−18d°) scale(1−.16|d|), filter blur(3|d|px) saturate, opacity 1−.4|d|, z-index. Reduced motion: opacity only.

name: Questionnaire
description: Typeform-style one-question-at-a-time form: answers slide the next question in from the direction of travel, the progress bar springs forward, number keys pick and Enter continues.
a11y: Each question is a fieldset with legend; options are radio/checkbox roles with aria-checked; progressbar with values; keyboard shortcuts 1–9 and Enter. Reduced motion: crossfade.
perf: One question mounted at a time (AnimatePresence mode=wait).
prompt: Build a one-question-at-a-time questionnaire with Motion: AnimatePresence mode=wait with direction-aware variants (enter from y=40·dir with blur, exit to y=−40·dir). Single-choice answers auto-advance after 260 ms; multi-choice shows Continue. Spring a progress bar width. Number keys pick options, Enter continues, a back button returns. Finish with a success state.

name: Vertical Marquee
description: Columns of cards scrolling endlessly up and down in alternating directions, masked to fade at the edges — the testimonial wall, in pure CSS.
a11y: Duplicated items are aria-hidden; hover/focus pauses; reduced motion shows a still wall.
perf: CSS transform animation only, zero JS; Server Component friendly.
prompt: Build a vertical marquee in pure CSS: a grid of columns, each a flex column containing its items twice (second copy aria-hidden) animated with translateY(0 → −50%) linear infinite; alternate columns reverse and vary duration by 15%. Mask top/bottom with a linear-gradient mask-image. Pause on hover/focus-within; no animation under reduced motion.

name: Gooey Tab Bar
description: Tab bar whose active blob oozes between items: an SVG goo filter merges the blob with a slower trailing droplet so they stretch and pinch like liquid.
a11y: Real buttons with aria-current; the goo layer is aria-hidden. Reduced motion: no filter, instant move.
perf: One SVG filter on a small layer with two moving circles.
prompt: Build a gooey tab bar: an inline SVG filter (feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 7 → feColorMatrix alpha 22 −9 → feComposite atop) applied to a layer with two circles — a big blob (stiff spring) and a smaller droplet (soft spring) both animating left to the active tab centre — so they merge and stretch. Icon buttons sit above the layer.

name: Expandable Floating Nav
description: A floating pill navbar that morphs into a full menu card with shared layout: the surface grows, links stagger in with blur, and Esc or outside click collapses it.
a11y: Toggle has aria-expanded/aria-controls; Esc closes and returns focus; links are real anchors. Reduced motion: instant open.
perf: One layout animation on the container; children use layout="position" to avoid distortion.
prompt: Build an expandable floating navbar with Motion: a motion.div with layout whose borderRadius animates 999 → 24 and width grows when open; the header row uses layout="position"; a two-line burger morphs into an X. Links stagger in with blur. Close on Escape (refocus toggle) and outside pointerdown.

name: Gravity Stars
description: A starfield where the cursor is a gravity well: nearby stars curve toward it with a swirl, streak while moving, then spring home. Stars twinkle at rest.
a11y: Decorative canvas (aria-hidden). Reduced motion: a single static frame.
perf: useCanvas pauses off-screen/hidden; 220 particles, O(n) per frame.
prompt: Build a gravity starfield on canvas: each star has home, position and velocity. Each frame, if the pointer is inside, add an inverse-square pull toward it plus a perpendicular component (swirl); always add a weak spring toward home and damp velocity by .94. Draw a streak when fast, otherwise a twinkling dot. Reseed on resize. Pause off-screen and render one frame under reduced motion.

name: Square Pattern
description: A grid of small squares lit by a travelling wave — diagonal sweep, radial pulse or digital rain — with a soft glow under the cursor.
a11y: Decorative canvas. Reduced motion: one static frame.
perf: fillRect per cell (~2–3k cells), paused off-screen.
prompt: Build a square-pattern background on canvas: a grid of cell−gap squares. Brightness = .06 + max(0, wave)³·.55 where wave is sin((x+y)·.35 − 2.4t) (diagonal), sin(dist·.5 − 2.6t) (radial) or a per-column falling head with an 8-cell tail (rain); add a glow within 140 px of the pointer.

name: Aurora Bars
description: Soft vertical light bars rising from the bottom edge, each breathing at its own pace — an aurora curtain built from scaleY-only CSS keyframes.
a11y: aria-hidden decoration; reduced motion freezes bars mid-height.
perf: Pure CSS transforms; deterministic per-bar values so SSR matches.
prompt: Build aurora bars: a flex row of N blurred, rounded-top bars at the bottom of a container with a gradient (base→mid→tip). Each bar animates transform: scaleY between two per-bar values (taller in the middle), with its own duration (4–9 s) and negative delay, transform-origin bottom. Mask the top with a gradient. Use deterministic pseudo-random values for SSR.

name: Ambient Glow Media
description: YouTube-style ambient mode: the image or video is drawn into a tiny canvas behind itself, scaled and blurred, so its own colours spill around the frame.
a11y: Glow canvas is aria-hidden; video is muted. Reduced motion: video doesn't autoplay and the glow doesn't resample.
perf: 32×18 canvas resampled at ~6 fps for video, once for images; the blur is a CSS filter on a tiny bitmap.
props: Image or video URL (same-origin or CORS-enabled).
prompt: Build an ambient glow wrapper: a 32×18 canvas absolutely positioned behind the media (scale 1.1, blur-3xl, saturate 150%). Draw the media into it with drawImage — once on image load, or every ~160 ms for video. Media must be same-origin or crossOrigin=anonymous.

name: View Switch Icons
description: A list / compact / cards view switcher whose glyphs are the same four rectangles morphing between layouts, with a pill sliding under the active mode.
a11y: radiogroup with labelled radio buttons. Reduced motion: instant.
perf: Springs on SVG rect attributes; layoutId pill.
prompt: Build a view switcher: a radiogroup of three buttons; each icon is an SVG with four motion.rect elements whose x/y/width/height animate to one of three layouts (list rows with thumbnails, compact lines, 2×2 cards) with a bouncy spring and small per-rect delay. A layoutId pill slides under the active button. Pair it with a grid that animates layout.

name: Pinned List
description: A list where pinning an item flies it up into the Pinned section with a shared-layout transition while the rest close the gap.
a11y: Pin buttons have aria-pressed and a descriptive label; they appear on hover and on focus. Reduced motion: instant reorder.
perf: layoutId per row; only moved rows animate.
prompt: Build a pinned list with Motion: two lists (Pinned, All). Each row is a motion.li with layoutId = item id, so toggling pin unmounts it from one list and mounts it in the other with a shared-layout flight. Section header fades in/out with AnimatePresence. Pin button shows on hover/focus, aria-pressed.

name: Aurora Card
description: A quiet card that wakes on hover: drifting aurora blobs fade in behind frosted glass and lean toward the cursor via CSS variables.
a11y: Purely decorative layer; content stays readable at rest. Pointer lean is off on touch and reduced motion; blob drift stops under reduced motion.
perf: CSS keyframes on three blurred blobs; pointer updates two CSS variables (no React renders).
prompt: Build an aurora card: three large blurred blobs drifting (rotate/translate/scale keyframes, different durations) in a layer at 30% opacity that rises to 100% on hover/focus-within; the layer translates by CSS vars --mx/--my set from the pointer. Content sits on a backdrop-blur card surface inset by 1 px so the light shows as a border.

name: Pixel Scroll Transition
description: A scroll-scrubbed pixel dissolve between two sections: squares fill in random order to cover the first, then clear in a new order to reveal the second.
a11y: Pixel grid is aria-hidden; both sections stay in the DOM. Reduced motion: a simple crossfade at the midpoint.
perf: Opacity toggles on a few hundred cells, only in a rAF-throttled scroll handler.
prompt: Build a pixel scroll transition: a 300vh section with a sticky viewport stacking `from`, `to` and a grid of cells. Precompute two random rank arrays. On scroll compute progress p; for p<.45 a cell is on if rankIn < p/.45; after .55 a cell is on while rankOut ≥ (p−.55)/.45; swap which section is visible at .5. Reduced motion: crossfade.

name: Typing Placeholder Input
description: A search field whose placeholder types out example queries, pauses and deletes them — and stops the moment you focus or type.
inspiration: unlumen UI — Animate Text Input Typing
a11y: A real static placeholder is set for assistive tech; the animated text is aria-hidden and hidden on focus. Reduced motion: suggestions swap whole.
perf: setTimeout loop only while idle; stops on focus/value.
props: Pause when a query is complete.
prompt: Build an input with an animated placeholder: while the field is empty and unfocused, an aria-hidden overlay types suggestions character by character (55 ms ± jitter), pauses, deletes at double speed and moves to the next. Hide the native placeholder visually (placeholder:text-transparent) but keep it for screen readers. Stop on focus or value.
